'''DecipherCon 1999 photographs''' are stills Decipher posted from [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999) at the Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia.<ref name="idx">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000122111458/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/index.html DecipherCon 1999 photo index], Decipher (Wayback 22 January 2000)</ref> The convention hosted the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].
